newsitem.title: INDIA: New Delhi houses collapse, 15 feared trapped.
newsitem.headline: New Delhi houses collapse, 15 feared trapped.

text.p: At least 15 people were feared trapped after two three-storey buildings collapsed in New Delhi on Thursday, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.

PTI, quoting fire brigade sources, said about six people were rushed to hospital by local residents after the collapse, apparently caused by the explosion of a cooking gas cylinder, in the Mongolpuri slum area of the Indian capital.
Police and fire officials were immediately not available for comment.
